data.name: Deepashri
data.gender_notes: Deepashri is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Deepa (light) + Ashri (knowledge or wisdom). This name signifies the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. The divine goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, is often depicted holding a lamp (Deepa) in her hand. Hence, Deepashri is a name that evokes the goddess's blessings. The name Deepashri carries the meaning “Light of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deepashri usually hope their child will grow to embody light of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Goddess Saraswati's divine blessings of wisdom and knowledge
data.etymology: Deepashri belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deepashri total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
